children: AtlasClear Holdings entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Debenture Agreement with Sixth Borough Capital to extend the maturity of its $500,000 loan. The amendment moves the due date from Aug 3, 2026 to Feb 3, 2027, with provisions for accelerated repayment under certain conditions. The counterparty is controlled by director Robert D. Keyser, Jr. The extension is intended to preserve near-term liquidity while the company advances its plans.
: Amendment to Debenture extending loan maturity
: Extend loan maturity and preserve near-term liquidity
